message:
Yen receipts now show correctly: `Paid ¥500 by card` instead of `¥5.00`. `npm test` passes (18 tests, 0 failures).

The bug is in the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, which is wrong for yen because yen has no minor unit. That file is outside `src/payments`, so I didn't touch it. Instead I added a small zero-decimal currency check in `src/payments/receipt.js`. For JPY it prints the amount as is, and every other currency still goes through `formatMoney`.

Invoices, cart and admin also use `formatMoney`, so they will probably still show yen wrong. The better fix is to make `formatMoney` handle zero-decimal currencies, which would let me drop the workaround in receipts. That change belongs to the team that owns `src/utils`.
